_comment: IMMUTABLE facts extracted from the AutoRL literature. NEVER mix with experiment_results/. Defines the domain-standard conventions this study follows and the baselines it benchmarks ADR against.

primary_benchmark.name: ARLBench
primary_benchmark.citation: Becktepe, Dierkes, et al. (2024, updated 2026). ARLBench: Flexible and Efficient Benchmarking for Hyperparameter Optimization in Reinforcement Learning. arXiv:2409.18827
environment_tiers: classic control (Gymnax; CartPole is the quickstart)

baselines_used_in_this_study.random_search: static; sample configs from the search space, run to completion, pick best.
baselines_used_in_this_study.hyperband: static + early stopping; successive halving allocates more budget to survivors (multi-fidelity).
baselines_used_in_this_study.pbt: adaptive; a population trains in parallel, poor performers copy weights from good ones (exploit) and perturb hyperparameters (explore). Jaderberg et al. 2017; on-the-fly PBT: arXiv:2106.15883.

llm_as_optimizer_reference.citation: Liu et al. (2024). AgentHPO: Large Language Model Agent for Hyper-Parameter Optimization. arXiv:2402.01881
llm_as_optimizer_reference.finding: LLM agents can reduce the number of trials vs traditional AutoML, especially under limited compute budgets; they do NOT consistently outperform classical HPO in all settings.
llm_as_optimizer_reference.role_in_study: motivates the ADR-LLM arm; we TEST rather than assume the benefit.

other_references.autorl_survey: Parker-Holder et al. (2022). Automated Reinforcement Learning (AutoRL): A Survey and Open Problems. arXiv:2201.05000
other_references.open_rl_benchmark: Huang et al. (2024). Open RL Benchmark. arXiv:2402.03046
other_references.duan_continuous_control: Duan et al. (2016). Benchmarking Deep RL for Continuous Control. arXiv:1604.06778 (kept only as a continuous-control reference)

positioning: ADR is not a new RL algorithm; it is an autonomous tuning/steering layer. The domain-standard way to validate such a method is ARLBench conventions: PPO on a representative env, compared against Random Search / Hyperband / PBT. This study does exactly that on CartPole (the ARLBench quickstart env), designed to extend to Brax/MinAtar tiers later.
